summary:
All 10 acceptance criteria are met. The fix was seen working on real data and in the shipped window.

**What the bug report assumed.** The bug report was only a title. I took the defect from the failing test and the index: TopLevelRowText.TitleOf printed a Done row's bare name even after a correction moved its figures.

**Code checks.** All of these pass:
- The SL-063 bug project: 10/10. The acceptance's own verdict belongs to the engine (O-001 is discharged), so this run is only a regression check.
- The full default Core.Tests suite: 381/381.
- The engine's Fitness: 61 rules hold.
- C-010 plus the acceptance, run 3 more times with 8 of 16 logical processors loaded: 60/60 fresh trees came out Done and Revised.
- Scanner.Execute sizes files only after the listing loop has emptied `_pending` (Scanner.cs:152-163), and Correct and Credit call `_owner.Check()`. So a correction can only reach a row that is already settled, and the order is structural, not timing.

**Real data, through Core and the App's own converter, polled every 250 ms like the window:**
- **C:\Windows** (41.5 s): 0 probe corrections, 0 revised rows, and all 119 Done rows show their bare names. This agrees with the spike and the build.
- **C:\ProgramData:** 16,309 real corrections reached 5 rows, and all 5 were marked with 0 rule violations. Each of those rows was first polled as an unrevised Done and then moved.
  - Most of the corrections are stale on-disk directory entries of hardlinks in `Microsoft\Windows\Containers\Layers`. `fsutil hardlink list` confirms they are hardlinks, not reparse points. The rest come from log files that are being written.
  - A second scan found 16,305 corrections again, so on this machine the "(revised)" mark on 'Microsoft' (and on 'ProgramData' in a full C:\ scan) recurs on every scan. It is not a rare event.

**The shipped exe, on real C:\ProgramData:** I republished it at HEAD and read its own TopLevelList from inside the process with a scratch startup hook (no UI Automation).
- **Tick path:** 'Microsoft' and 'ASUS' were drawn as a plain `Done`, then about 1 s later as `Microsoft  (revised)` and `ASUS  (revised)`.
- **Ending path:** after a real Cancel, ShowFinalTopLevel drew `Microsoft  (revised)`. The report says Cancelled, the list is visible and the folder tree is hidden.
- **On a Completed scan** the folder tree replaced the list about 200 ms after the mark first appeared. In practice a person barely sees the mark unless they stop the scan. This is the open person decision about the tree, not a defect against these criteria.

**What only tests reach.** Criteria 2, 3 (the 0/0 half), 4 and 7 describe shapes the real scanner cannot produce: every correction comes after listing, Correct only credits a real change, and Moved credits one row per call. They are met through the hand-driven tests.

**Two build-slice obligations are still open in the tree:**
- O-018: no test for the file-row half of the settle capture. I measured that it works today: `a-stale.bin  (revised)`.
- O-019: the Revised reader rule has no XAML twin.

**Two things outside these criteria that a person should know:**
- The header during a scan says only "Rows marked reading are still growing", but Done rows move during the probe pass.
- After a Cancel during the probe pass, Done rows keep unprobed listing figures with no mark. Here the cancelled total was about 748 MB short on-disk against the completed run, and the header says only not-read or stopped-partway rows are short.

**Housekeeping.** One of my commands was blocked by the engine's guard, which misread a Remove-Item of my own temp files as removing C:\ProgramData. Nothing ran; I re-ran it without Remove-Item. All scratch files are deleted, and the worktree has no changes from me.

Revised is latched only in Build, when the state is Done and (Bytes, OnDisk) differ from the pair Settle captured at pending 0.

Each was first polled as an unrevised Done and then moved. 0 violations. 'Microsoft' bytes were unchanged while on-disk went from 6,489,199,424 to 8,277,128,000.

checks.what: A full C:\ scan
checks.evidence: Not run: about 7 minutes of the person's machine. From the ProgramData result I predict the 'ProgramData' row would be marked on every scan, but I did not measure it.

criteria.criterion: 1. Mark a top-level row revised when a correction (Moved) changes bytes or on-disk of a row already Done, by a non-zero amount
criteria.how: C-001 passes. On real C:\ProgramData, 5 rows that were polled as unrevised Done later moved (real stale hardlink entries and growing logs) and all were marked. The shipped window drew 'ASUS' as Done, then 'ASUS  (revised)'. A top-level file-row variant is also marked.

criteria.criterion: 2. Moved changes a row still Reading (pending > 0): it is not marked
criteria.how: C-002 (hand-driven) passes. The real scanner cannot produce this shape: SizeFiles runs only after `_pending` is empty (Scanner.cs:152-163), so it is checked only through the test.

criteria.criterion: 3. Moved reports a zero-byte change on an already-Done row: 0/0 leaves it unmarked, and either figure alone marks it
criteria.how: C-003 passes (0/0 false, 0/4096 true, 100/0 true). Real: 'Microsoft' in ProgramData had unchanged bytes and on-disk +1.79 GB, and it was marked. A real 0/0 Moved cannot happen, because Correct credits only when sizes differ.

criteria.criterion: 4. A charge moving between two rows that are both already Done marks both
criteria.how: C-004 (hand-driven) passes and the rows still sum to the totals. The current scanner never moves a charge between rows (a correction credits only the first name's row), so there is no real case to observe.

criteria.criterion: 5. A Done row nothing ever corrected renders its bare name
criteria.how: C-005 passes. Real C:\Windows: 119 Done rows, 0 corrections, all bare, 0 title violations. ProgramData's uncorrected Done rows are bare, and the shipped window drew them bare (Adobe, NVIDIA Corporation, ...).

criteria.criterion: 6. A Done row whose figures were corrected in place after it settled renders differently from its bare name
criteria.how: The acceptance passes in my run (its verdict is the engine's, O-001). The shipped exe drew 'Microsoft  (revised)' and 'ASUS  (revised)' on real ProgramData.

criteria.criterion: 7. TitleOf given Revised=true with each non-Done state keeps that state's own words
criteria.how: C-007 passes over all 6 states. On real data no row was ever Revised outside Done (0 'revised-while' violations across C:\Windows and ProgramData).

criteria.criterion: 8. The suffix shows in the actual window, on both the live 250 ms tick list and the end-of-scan ShowFinalTopLevel list
criteria.how: C-008 passes. Real: in the shipped exe on real ProgramData, the tick path drew 'Microsoft  (revised)' at 44512 ms. After a real Cancel, the ending list drew 'Microsoft  (revised)' (report: Cancelled, TopLevelList realised, tree hidden). On a Completed scan the tree replaced the list about 200 ms after the mark appeared.

criteria.criterion: 9. A correction landing in the same ~250 ms interval in which the row first reaches Done is still marked (accepted over-marking)
criteria.how: Seen three times. The fresh stale tree and the file-row tree (polls=0) were both marked. On real ProgramData scan 2, 'Microsoft' was already Revised at its first poll and never seen unrevised. This matches the design's accepted over-marking.

criteria.criterion: 10. The acceptance test is deterministic: the repro tree's correction cannot race the settling of '1-folder'
criteria.how: The order is structural (Scanner.Execute:152-163; single owner thread). C-010 passed 20/20, then 60/60 more fresh trees across 3 rounds with 8 of 16 logical processors loaded, and the acceptance passed 4/4 runs.

obligations.evidence: Revised is latched only in TopLevelTracker.Build, when the computed state is Done (Started, Pending==0, !OwnUnreadable) and (Bytes, OnDisk) differ from the pair Settle captured when pending reached 0 (TopLevelTracker.cs:72-73, 95-96, 195-196). Seed, FolderExited, Moved, Corrected and Finish run only on the scan's thread: Correct and Credit call _owner.Check() (Scanner.cs:415, 444), and no lock is needed. Real: in the shipped window on ProgramData, 'Microsoft' was drawn as a plain Done at 43441 ms and as '(revised)' at 44512 ms. Caveat: the tracker knows the row was Done, not that it was published. A row settled and corrected within one interval is marked without ever being shown unrevised. That is the accepted C-009 over-marking, observed for real on ProgramData scan 2.

Structural: the listing loop empties `_pending` before SizeFiles (Scanner.cs:152-163), so '1-folder' is at pending 0 before any probe correction. Measured: C-010 passed 20/20 in the plain run and 60/60 more under 8-core load (3 rounds). The acceptance passed in all 4 of my runs.

Owed to build-slice and not done: TopLevelTests has no file-row Revised fact; every Revised test builds folder rows. The behaviour is correct today: a fresh tree with root\a-stale.bin hardlinked to sub\current.bin (grown by 63 MiB) gave 'a-stale.bin  (revised)', Done, 67,108,864 bytes. The guard asked for is still missing.

Owed to build-slice and not done: .taad/fitness.yaml has only the two .cs rules (lines 784 and 794) and no `src/FsAnalyser.App/*.xaml` twin forbidding `\bRevised\b`. I did not re-plant the XAML; code-review measured the gap.

not_reached: The shipped exe's own proof path: schema-1 --report has no revised or per-row field, and no FsaWindowHook mode reads the list mid-scan. My window evidence comes from a scratch in-process startup hook (deleted afterwards), so no committed window case checks the mark.

A full C:\ scan in the shipped app: not run (about 7 minutes of the machine). From ProgramData's stable 16k container-layer hardlink corrections, I predict the 'ProgramData' row would read '(revised)' on every scan of this PC, but I did not measure it.

A real charge moving between two Done rows (criterion 4) and a real correction on a still-Reading row (criterion 2): the current scanner cannot produce either, so only the hand-driven tests reach them.

The original validate observation (a Done row on C:\Windows moving, with 47,409 later hardlink names in another row) did not recur. C:\Windows had 0 probe corrections, which agrees with the spike and the build. The fix was exercised on ProgramData's real stale hardlinks instead.

On a Completed scan the folder tree replaces the list. On real ProgramData the mark was drawn for about 200 ms before the tree replaced it, so a person rarely sees it unless they press Stop. Whether tree nodes should carry the mark is the open person decision.

Outside the 10 criteria, for a person: the scanning header says only 'Rows marked reading are still growing', but Done rows moved by up to 1.79 GB on-disk during the probe pass. After a Cancel during the probe pass, Done rows keep unprobed listing figures with no mark: this cancelled run's on-disk total was about 748 MB below the completed run's. Yet the header says only not-read or stopped-partway rows are short. That is a residual implication of finality that nothing marks.

Why the ProgramData container-layer hardlink entries stay stale across scans, when the build's test tree was refreshed by one probe: I measured that it is stable (16,309 then 16,305 corrections), but not why.
